name: Sudan
summary: Record drone attacks on civilians in October; army rejects talks
state: Strikes on a market and homes in RSF-held Nyala on 26 Oct killed more than 100 people according to the rights group Emergency Lawyers; medical groups gave lower figures. The UN says drones are now the leading cause of civilian deaths. A senior RSF commander, Siddiq Ander, announced his defection on 31 Oct. About 14 million people are displaced.
for_you: Sudan is the world's largest displacement crisis. Aid agencies report severe funding shortfalls.
rubric_hit: Major sieges or massacres reported, or famine spreading to new areas.
